newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 8c to 621c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 8c to 621c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator rose another eight cents to 621 cents a kg clean on Thursday at sales in Sydney and Launceston, Wool International said.

All merino fleece categories strengthened, with 19/20/21/25 microns 1.5 percent dearer, 22/23m two percent dearer and 24m 0.5 percent dearer, with merino skirtings 21m and finer up to two percent dearer.
Crossbreds also gained with 26/29m one percent dearer, 27/28/30m 0.5 percent dearer and 31m slightly dearer, it said.
In cardings, locks and crutchings were generally unchanged.
WI said Japan, Western Europe and China were the principal buyers with support from the United States and most sectors.
Of the 24,201 bales offered, 3.2 percent were passed in.
Sales continue next week in Newcastle, Melbourne and Fremantle with about 93,680 bales to be offered.
